verses.text_en: I was small among my brothers, and youngest in my father’s house. I tended my father’s sheep.
verses.text_hr: Bio sam malen među svojom braćom i najmlađi u kući svoga oca. Čuvao sam ovce svoga oca.

verses.text_en: My hands formed a musical instrument, and my fingers tuned a lyre.
verses.text_hr: Moje su ruke načinile glazbalo, a moji su prsti ugodili liru.

verses.text_en: Who shall tell my Lord? The Lord himself, he himself hears.
verses.text_hr: Tko će kazati mome Gospodinu? Sam Gospodin, on sam sluša.

verses.text_en: He sent forth his angel and took me from my father’s sheep, and he anointed me with his anointing oil.
verses.text_hr: Poslao je svoga anđela i uzeo me od ovaca moga oca; pomazao me uljem svojega pomazanja.

verses.text_en: My brothers were handsome and tall; but the Lord didn’t take pleasure in them.
verses.text_hr: Moja su braća bila lijepa i visoka, ali Gospodinu nisu bila po volji.

verses.text_en: I went out to meet the Philistine, and he cursed me by his idols.
verses.text_hr: Izašao sam ususret Filistejcu, a on me prokleo svojim idolima.

verses.text_en: But I drew his own sword and beheaded him, and removed reproach from the children of Israel.
verses.text_hr: Ali izvukao sam njegov vlastiti mač, odrubio mu glavu i skinuo sramotu sa sinova Izraelovih.
